exact_result: Under explicit scalar-curve comparison, unit-harmonic, and conventional LFS-presentation foundations F1-F3, a tropical upper-semicontinuous obstacle with a finite convex minorant on a bounded open convex split-torus domain has full noninvariant continuous scalar-psh and full LFS raw envelopes equal to its finite continuous convex tropical envelope. Both full families commute exactly with every analytic scalar extension, and their regularizations are scalar-compatible. The exact original real-PL/LFS union application remains conditional on the unproved real-PL bridge; no sharp classification is claimed.
concrete_gaps: The exact classical curve definition and standard foundations F1-F2 were not verified from the full primary source; only its public abstract and metadata were obtained.

Identification of the exact original LFS class with F3 and scalar-stable curve positivity of every semipositive real-PL competitor remain unverified; hence the full original union conclusion is conditional.
Arbitrary non-tropical obstacles, obstacles without a finite convex minorant including minus-infinity values, and target domains with relative boundary are outside the proved sector.
No normal or geometrically unibranch higher-dimensional sharp classification, singular-target theorem, or necessary branched/nonsplit-node/codimension-two pinching analysis is proved.
Outside the computed conditional toric sector, scalar extension of the ground-field regularization and local-to-global compatibility of the full original family remain unresolved.
